tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refutes the proposed coupled ODE at the required tolerance, while the observations show no high-frequency chaotic-sign signature requiring abstention. A further targeted trajectory batch is the only useful available probe to resolve the remaining mechanism ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory-kernel ODE again
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh-confirmation RMSE of 0.080412 exceeds the 0.045 tolerance; existing evidence does not justify simply refitting the same mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static siphon or Hill-inhibition model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These are plausible alternatives, but current observations do not distinguish them from other nonlinear mechanisms after the ODE was refuted.
